messages:
ryan: Heads up — planning a short maintenance window SAT 02:00-03:30 UTC to roll NIC firmware + graceful GPU node reboots in eu-west3. This is a staggered rolling reboot across 3 cohorts, ~20% pool at a time. low-traffic window.

ryan: Goal: apply NIC fix that reduces rx stall + pre-seed KV cache after reboots to avoid cold-token spikes. We'll do canary on sat 02:00, then cohorts at 02:20 / 02:50 / 03:10.

ryan: Expected impact: brief token latency spikes (~200–400ms p95) for affected cohort during node handoff; throughput unchanged overall. We'll route a small % to fallback pool during individual cohort drains.

sarah: SLA question — any chance we hit >1m request errors?

ryan: Unlikely. We'll keep canary traffic at 1% and abort if error rate >0.5% for 5m. fallback rules already configured to send to dedicated fallback pool.

kai: How are we seeding KV cache? I want the script + timing so eviction doesn't thrash.

olivia: I'll own observability: setting auto-alerts on latency & 5xxs, trace sampling up for canary. Add me to incident duty if we see >0.5% 5xx.

ryan: KV seed plan: after each node rejoins, run prefix prewarm with small-batch replays from recent hot sessions (5k toks/min sustained for 3m). Script: 

```bash
# run on controller for cohort N
python infra/tools/kv_seed.py --pool eu-west3-cohort-N --session-file /tmp/hot_sessions.json --rate 80
```

ryan: We'll throttle prewarm to avoid egress spikes. Target steady-state warmup < 5% added token load.

jamal: Cost note — warm preseed will add ~0.4% token usage for the night; estimate ~$120 extra for the window. We can reduce rate if finance flags it.

sarah: Tenant notifications? we should ping any high-SLA customers in eu-west3. I'll draft a short banner.

olivia: Also will enable request-level tracing for canary model routes so we can correlate latency deltas to node id.

ryan: Deployment plan (summarized):
1) 02:00 canary cohort: cordon + drain -> apply NIC fw -> reboot -> join -> kv_seed -> sanity checks 02:12
2) 02:20 cohort A -> same flow
3) 02:50 cohort B -> same flow
4) 03:10 last cohort -> final validation + edge traffic shift back

ryan: Cordoning commands (runbook snippet):
```bash
kubectl cordon node-xxx
kubectl drain node-xxx --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=60 --timeout=10m
```

kai: For draining, add `--pod-selector=app!=monitoring` for our infra-critical monitoring pods. Otherwise we might evict the exporter pods.

olivia: I'll update dashboards and add a temporary status panel for cohort progress.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job created: maintenance/gpu-node-fw-eu-west3 @ 2026-06-14T02:00:00Z — runbook link: https://go/redwood/runbooks/fw-eu-west3

ryan: Can people ack + callouts? I want at least one SRE and one infra dev on-call for window.

sarah: Ack — I'll send tenant banner and be on standby 02:00-04:00 UTC.

kai: Ack — I'll handle the kv_seed orchestration and rate limiting knobs.

olivia: Ack — observability + canary tracing live. I'll escalate if p95 > 500ms for >10m.

jamal: Ack — tracking cost delta and will notify finance if it goes >$200.

ryan: Thanks. If no objections, we'll proceed. Leave any constraints here (e.g., customer events) before EOD FRIDAY so we can reschedule. :thumbsup:
